column1: # Clauses of LRM Clause 12 (docs/ch12-vpi-routines.html) classified rather
# than given a rejection fixture, each with the text that makes it so.

column3: A means of initializing system task/function callbacks and performing any other desired task just after the simulator is invoked shall be provided by placing routines in a NULL-terminated static array, vlog_startup_routines ... (Callbacks can also be registered or removed at any time during an application routine, not just at startup time). — it grants a mechanism and states no invalid input to refuse. Positive: tests/fixtures/ch11_vpi/p04_05_vlog_info.c (runs from the table, in vpi_runs) and every other vpi_runs application.

Arguments: NONE this function accepts no arguments ... It returns the elapsed time between the latest converged and accepted solution and the solution being calculated. The function shall return zero (0) during DC or the time zero transient solution. — a query with no input to be invalid and no failure the clause names. Positive: p03_01 (0 at the time zero solution, > 0 after) and p03_02 (delta == t_k − t_{k−1} at every accepted point), both in vpi_runs.

Arguments: NONE this function accepts no arguments ... The function shall return zero (0) during DC or transient analysis. — no input to be invalid. Positive: p03_01 asserts 0 at the time zero solution and at every accepted point of a transient (in vpi_runs).

Arguments: NONE this function accepts no arguments ... shall be used determine the time of the solution attempted or of the latest converged and accepted solution otherwise. The function shall return zero (0) during DC or the time zero transient solution. — no input to be invalid. Positive: p03_01, p03_02 (strictly increasing accepted times ending at tstop) and p03_03 (the forced times, exactly), in vpi_runs.
